criteria.requirement: Fix attr.converters.optional for first-parameter and return annotations stored as strings, including unknown forward references. Build a valid optional annotation representation without evaluating arbitrary annotation text or changing the original converter annotations. Preserve actual-type annotations, unannotated/builtin callables, None bypass and Converter takes_self/takes_field forwarding. The wrapped converter must still execute normally for non-None values.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
